<section class="section" style="padding-top:56px"><div class="wrap"><div class="sec-title"><span class="eyebrow">ABOUT</span><h2>Two teachers who found answers in the classroom</h2><p>The roots of PLUSZONE Education are not in theory but in the classroom. The answers two teachers found through <b>34 and 22 years</b> of working with children became the starting point of this education.</p></div><div class="people"><div class="person"><span class="prole">School health teacher, 34 years</span><h3>Kim Kyeong Hyi</h3><div class="badges"><span>34 years as a health teacher</span><span>Nursing</span><span>Counseling education</span></div><p>Studied nursing at university and counseling education in graduate school. Caring not only for the bodies but also for the hurting hearts of children who come to the health room, has seen children recover so fully that medicine was no longer needed, through character education that helps them change a single thought and a single feeling.</p><p>Believing that teachers must first have good character in order to teach it, applies this to themself first every day and walks the path of growing together with students.</p></div><div class="person"><span class="prole">Elementary school teacher, 22 years</span><h3>Kim Hye-jin</h3><div class="badges"><span>22 years as an elementary teacher</span><span>Elementary education</span><span>Doctoral coursework in education</span></div><p>Graduated from a university of education, earned a master’s degree in educational counseling and completed doctoral coursework in education. Dreamed of a happy teaching life, but reality was not easy: children who swore at teachers, and parents who overprotected or neglected. Has worked to find ways to teach character “without burning out.”</p><p>Keeps records of experiences with children, explores how teachers, students and parents can all stand upright in character, and moves forward step by step with the resolve “I will become a right person first.”</p></div></div></div></section><section class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="bookband"><img src="booke.jpg" alt="Cover of A Teacher's Guide to the Art of Character Education"><div><span class="lbl">The two authors’ classroom record</span><h3>A Teacher’s Guide to the Art of Character Education</h3><span class="en">Higher Rapport · Korean edition: 『인성교육, 참! 잘하는 교사』</span><p class="by">Kim Kyeong Hyi · Kim Hye-jin &nbsp;|&nbsp; Insaeng Books &nbsp;·&nbsp; <a href="book.html">About the book →</a></p><blockquote>“There are mistakes in our education, but no failures.”<small>— from the book</small></blockquote></div></div></div></section><section class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="sec-title"><span class="eyebrow">OUR PHILOSOPHY</span><h2>The joy of growth by choosing PLUS (+)</h2><p>Everyone wants to live happily. PLUSZONE Education helps people <b>discover the minus</b> that creates the gap between who they want to be and who they are now, and experience <b>the joy of choosing plus</b> for themselves.</p></div><div class="note-box"><b>(+,+): the growth of consciousness</b> — Education that shows how your life becomes plus (+) when you meet every thought and way of living actively, proactively and positively.</div></div></section><section class="section"><div class="wrap"><div class="sec-title"><span class="eyebrow">A SINGLE THOUGHT</span><h2>A Single Thought</h2></div><div class="poem"><p>Here is a single thought.<br>A single thought gives rise to a person’s words.<br>A person’s words give rise to their actions.<br>Their actions give rise to their habits.<br>Their habits shape the atmosphere of a place.</p><p>The atmosphere of a place<br>shapes the values and customs<br>of a family, a workplace, and a society.<br>The values and customs of a society<br>shape the history of an era.</p><p>Therefore, ask yourself:<br>What kind of thought are you holding?<br>What kind of words are you speaking?<br>What kind of actions are you taking?<br>Look back and reflect.</p><p>Know that the single thought<br>you are holding at this very moment<br>is shaping your destiny<br>and creating your future and your history.</p><p>With what single thought are you making history?<br>With what single thought<br>are you painting the picture of your life?</p><p>Are you following others and copying their pictures?<br>Or are you painting a picture of your own?<br>Are you painting a picture that is stained and ugly?<br>Or one filled with beauty and grace?<br>Or are you merely dressing it up for appearances?</p><p>With a single thought,<br>I have painted the picture of my life.<br>With clarity and meticulous care,<br>I have shaped every detail of my life —<br>making each and every step<br>joyful and beautiful.</p><p class="sig">written by Sang Dae
